subject.title: System prompt: add guidance for spawning background sub-agents

question: Should this stale maintainer-labeled prompt-policy PR be rebased and consolidated into existing sub-agent guidance, changed into a coherent no-nested-spawn policy, or closed manually as covered by current main?
rationale: The branch is small, but it changes model-facing delegation policy where current main already has overlapping guidance and supports configured nested spawning.

options.title: Rebase And Consolidate Guidance
options.body: Keep only useful examples and merge them into the existing Tooling, Messaging, child-prompt, or tool-description surfaces after rebasing.

options.title: Change Nested Policy Coherently
options.body: If nested spawning should be forbidden, update runtime config, docs, tests, and prompt surfaces together.

options.title: Close As Covered
options.body: If current main guidance is sufficient, a maintainer can close this protected stale branch manually instead of carrying duplicate prompt text.

recommendation.title: Rebase And Consolidate Guidance
recommendation.body: Keep only useful examples and merge them into the existing Tooling, Messaging, child-prompt, or tool-description surfaces after rebasing.

likelyOwner.reason: They proposed the prompt-policy direction and already made a product-direction call in this PR discussion.
